puzzleHints.stage1: Complete the group above the core: it falls with the group.
puzzleHints.stage2: Rust blocks the group: paint it with the Brush.
puzzleHints.stage3: Clear every sphere: Lightning strikes a whole row.
puzzleHints.stage4: Two shots, one color: build a group of three with the core on the platform.
puzzleHints.stage5: Two cores, two tools: a group on one side, the Prism on the other.
puzzleHints.stage6: The barrier covers the core: go through the portal.
puzzleHints.stage7: The order is fixed: break the Quantum Lock first, then free the core.
puzzleHints.stage8: Set off the Paint Core: the rust takes its color and can be grouped.
puzzleHints.stage9: Wake the Dormant Barrels: their blasts clear the board.
puzzleHints.stage10: The core hangs from a Chained Sphere on the rotor: build a group of three on it.

tutorial.pendulum: Match 3+ same-color spheres or sever upper anchors to trigger a magnetic avalanche!
tutorial.rotor: The central rotor spins dynamically from sphere weight balance and shot impact torque.
tutorial.repulsor: Repulsive cores bend your shot: trust the curved laser, and flip polarity (🧲) if a sphere pulls it the wrong way!
tutorial.portal: Shoot into a Quantum Portal to teleport your projectile past moving barriers!
tutorial.boss: Boss Cores (👑) have 3 shields and burst into a shower of coins when destroyed!
tutorial.magnetar: A Magnetar can't be broken. Snap the anchors holding it (dashed lines) and it falls. Its badge shows what it does next turn.
tutorial.laserLock: Destroy all Lock Cores (🔒) to disable the energy barrier!
tutorial.singularity: Avalanche spheres pulled into the Singularity Vortex grant bonus points & Overcharge!
tutorial.neutralAnchor: Gray anchors (⚓) never break in a match: cut the spheres around them, and they crumble once nothing hangs from them!
tutorial.chained: Chained spheres (⛓) never snap loose when stretched: blast them with a bomb, or destroy the spheres they hold!
tutorial.bubble: Bubbled spheres (◌) cannot join a group: hit them, or clear a group next to them, to pop the bubble!
tutorial.cores: Colored cores go off when their group is destroyed: ❄ freezes, ⚡ strikes the row, 🎨 repaints the neighbors!
tutorial.rail: Rail anchors slide along their track: clear one side and the weight of the other drags the anchor!
tutorial.thruster: Thrusters (⏫) push their cluster up: destroy them and the cluster sags toward the danger line!
tutorial.tether: Tether spheres (∿) hold distant spheres with long links that never snap: cut the tether sphere to drop them!
tutorial.rust: Rust (⚙) blocks every group: blast it, drop it, or paint it. Rockets (🚀) seek out the hardest targets!
tutorial.platform: Support platforms hold hanging spheres from below while letting your shots pass right through!
tutorial.antimagnet: Antimagnet cushions push hanging clusters upward without bending your shots!
tutorial.rescueCore: Free all Rescue Cores (💎) by matching or dropping them to trigger an instant avalanche victory!
tutorial.puzzle: Puzzle: a fixed queue, no swap, no shop and no Workshop upgrades. Read the board, then shoot.

polarity.pointer: Click the 🧲 button (or press F) to flip your shot's charge: spheres then pull it the other way, so it curves in the opposite direction.
polarity.touch: Tap the 🧲 button to flip your shot's charge: spheres then pull it the other way, so it curves in the opposite direction.
polarity.gamepad: Press the top face button to flip your shot's charge (the 🧲 button works too): spheres then pull it the other way, so it curves in the opposite direction.

tutorial.bankShot: Bounce your shot off the walls and bumpers to reach spheres you cannot hit head-on.

specials.bomb: Bomb: blasts every sphere around where it lands. Select its glowing slot, then shoot.
specials.lightning: Lightning: wipes out a whole horizontal chain of spheres. Select its glowing slot, then shoot.
specials.rainbow: Prism: counts as any adjacent color, so it always makes a match. Select its glowing slot, then shoot.
specials.anvil: Anvil: punches through and crushes every sphere in its path. Select its glowing slot, then shoot.
specials.freeze: Cryo: freezes the descent and calms the magnetic sway. Select its glowing slot, then shoot.
specials.rocket: Rocket: fires three homing rockets at the toughest spheres. Select its glowing slot, then shoot.
specials.brush: Brush: repaints nearby spheres into one color and scrubs off rust. Select its glowing slot, then shoot.

tutorial.resonance: Resonance: the ring around the launcher closes on every beat of the music. Shoot while it is solid and bright: a Resonant shot that matches or drops fills more Overcharge.
tutorial.sag: Sag: every shot that clears nothing fills the Sag meter beside the launcher. When it is full, the cluster drops closer. Avalanches drain it.

polarity.name: Polarity Inversion
polarity.description: Flips your shot's magnetic charge (F key or 🧲 button): spheres then pull your shot the other way, so it curves in the opposite direction. Attractors and repulsors are not affected.

collectors.name: Magnetic Collector Bins
collectors.description: The 5 energized slots at the bottom of the board catch every falling avalanche sphere for bonus points and Overcharge.

overcharge.name: Overcharge Gauge
overcharge.description: Fills with every cleared group and collected sphere. When full, it automatically forges a free Special Sphere.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.description: Unlocked during the campaign. The ring around the launcher closes on each beat; a shot released while it is solid is Resonant and earns extra Overcharge, or hits charges harder in a Polarity Duel. Off in Purist and in competitive runs.

sag.name: Sag
sag.description: In Survival, Daily and Purist, each shot that clears nothing fills the Sag meter; when it is full the cluster drops. Avalanches drain it.

hyperGravity.description: Stronger gravity pulls the cluster down faster (+25% score).

turboRotors.description: Inertia rotors spin much faster under torque (+20% score).

superMagnetism.description: Magnetic poles attract and repel with greater force (+20% score).

volatileCluster.description: Extra Dormant Barrels spawn inside the cluster (+30% score).

portalMatrix.description: Linked Quantum Portals warp shots past the central rotor (+25% score).

bumperPinball.description: Twin Energy Bumpers flank the rotor for high-speed bank shots (+20% score).

cryoSurge.description: Extra Freeze and Lightning Cores spawn across the cluster (+25% score).

armored.name: Armored Sphere
armored.description: Requires 2 matches or blasts to shatter.

dormantBomb.name: Dormant Barrel
dormantBomb.description: Detonates when destroyed, blasting nearby cluster spheres.

chameleon.name: Chameleon Sphere
chameleon.description: Cycles its magnetic color after every turn.

coinCore.name: Coin Core
coinCore.description: Awards bonus coins when matched or dropped in an avalanche.

bossCore.name: Boss Core
bossCore.description: Protected by 3 shields. Bursts into a massive coin and score bounty.

laserLock.name: Quantum Lock
laserLock.description: Destroy all Lock Cores in the level to disable energy barriers.

neutralAnchor.name: Neutral Anchor
neutralAnchor.description: A gray anchor no match can break. Bombs, lightning and the anvil remove it, and it crumbles once nothing hangs from it.

chained.name: Chained Sphere
chained.description: Its links never snap when stretched. Only an explosion, or destroying a linked sphere, sets it free.

bubble.name: Bubble Sphere
bubble.description: Cannot join a group until its bubble pops: hit it, or destroy a group right next to it.

freezeCore.name: Freeze Core
freezeCore.description: Freezes the spheres around it for a few turns when destroyed.

lightningCore.name: Lightning Core
lightningCore.description: Strikes its whole row with lightning when destroyed.

paintCore.name: Paint Core
paintCore.description: Repaints nearby spheres in its color when destroyed, setting up new groups.

thruster.name: Thruster Sphere
thruster.description: Pushes upward against gravity, lifting the spheres bonded to it away from the danger line.

tether.name: Tether Sphere
tether.description: Binds to spheres farther away with long links that never snap. Long links hold weight but never join a color group.

rust.name: Rusted Sphere
rust.description: Colorless and inert: it never joins a group. Explosions, rockets, the anvil and avalanches remove it, and a Paint Core scrubs it back to a color.

rescueCore.name: Rescue Core
rescueCore.description: Captive prism core (💎). Free all Rescue Cores on the board to shatter the remaining cluster into an instant avalanche!

magnetar.name: Magnetar
magnetar.description: Unbreakable field core. Matches, bombs, lightning, rockets and the anvil do nothing to it: snap the Moorings (anchor spheres) holding it up and it falls in an avalanche. Its badge warns of what it does next turn.

pivot.name: Inertia Rotor
pivot.description: Spins dynamically based on cluster weight balance and shot impact torque.

bumper.name: Energy Bumper
bumper.description: Ricochets projectiles at high speed for trick bank shots.

repulsor.name: Repulsor Core
repulsor.description: Pushes and bends projectile trajectories passing through its field.

attractor.name: Gravity Well
attractor.description: Pulls and curves projectile trajectories toward its center.

barrier.name: Oscillating Barrier
barrier.description: Moving shield that blocks direct shots. Can be disabled via Quantum Locks.

portal.name: Quantum Portals
portal.description: Teleports projectiles instantaneously to the linked exit portal with a speed boost.

singularity.name: Singularity Vortex
singularity.description: Absorbs falling avalanche spheres for bonus score and Overcharge.

platform.name: Support Platform
platform.description: One-way shelf that holds hanging spheres from below while letting shots pass through.

antimagnet.name: Antimagnet Cushion
antimagnet.description: Repels nearby hanging cluster spheres without deflecting fired projectiles.

invert.name: Reverse field
invert.description: Every curve on your shot is reversed next turn. Flip polarity to cancel it.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.description: The core pulls your shot toward it inside a dotted field. Bank through it into a Mooring.

regrow.name: Regrow
regrow.description: Adds up to 3 spheres in the dashed slots next to the core. Fill a slot or snap a Mooring first.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.description: Fires charged spheres from the danger line. Shoot the opposite polarity to neutralise them.
